storyPoints.title: Od března se prodlužují dodací lhůty notebooků od dodavatele
storyPoints.description: Dodávky notebooků do DC se začínají opožďovat, což snižuje dostupnost zásob pro alokace na prodejny.

expectations.description: Backorder požadavků na notebooky na prodejnách výrazně vzroste po 1. 3.
expectations.sql:
SELECT 'before' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(1.0)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT b.date),0),0) AS value
FROM backorder b
JOIN product p ON p.id = b.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND b.date < '2024-03-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'after' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(1.0)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT b.date),0),0) AS value
FROM backorder b
JOIN product p ON p.id = b.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND b.date >= '2024-03-01'

expectations.description: Ztracené prodeje notebooků na prodejnách po 1. 3. výrazně vzrostou.
expectations.sql:
SELECT 'before' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(1.0)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.date),0),0) AS value
FROM lost_sale_nb l
WHERE l.date < '2024-03-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'after' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(1.0)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT l.date),0),0) AS value
FROM lost_sale_nb l
WHERE l.date >= '2024-03-01'

expectations.description: Expedice notebooků z DC na prodejny po 1. 3. klesnou vlivem opožděných dodávek do DC.
expectations.sql:
SELECT 'before' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.date),0),0) AS value
FROM store_shipment s
JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND s.date < '2024-03-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'after' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.date),0),0) AS value
FROM store_shipment s
JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'notebook' AND s.date >= '2024-03-01'

expectations.description: Prodané množství zboží mimo notebooky zůstává stabilní (kontrola na neovlivněný sortiment).
expectations.sql:
SELECT 'before' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.date),0),0) AS value
FROM store_sale s
JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE p.category <> 'notebook' AND s.date < '2024-03-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'after' AS period, COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.date),0),0) AS value
FROM store_sale s
JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE p.category <> 'notebook' AND s.date >= '2024-03-01'
